name: Reefwrack Drake
speed: 40 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 40 ft., Climb 40 ft.
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 16

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The drake makes three Jaws attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Hooked Lash.

Actions.name: Jaws
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. 26 (6d6 + 5) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Brine Spray (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 67 (15d8) Acid damage. *Success:* Half damage.
Actions.clause: spits the bones back as chum
answersAlso: spits the bones back as chum

Actions.name: Hooked Lash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one Huge or smaller creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 30 feet straight toward the drake by its jaws and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled this way, the target has the Restrained condition.

Traits.name: Beaching Surge
Traits.text: Difficult Terrain composed of coral shelves and beached timbers doesn't cost the drake extra movement, and the drake can move across coral shelves and beached timbers without needing to make an ability check.

lore: A dragon that has sunk whole shipwrecks into its reef and grown fat on crews, it wants nothing more than another keel on the coral and another flock of gulls to clean up after it.
